name: US Industrials/Materials Momentum Long-Only (12M)
description: Long-only momentum strategy on 10 US industrial/materials equities (CENX, CLF, CMC, STLD, FCX, SCCO, AA, NUE, X, RS). Uses 12-month (252-day) rate of change as the momentum signal. Goes long the top 3 stocks by momentum, equal-weighted. Rebalances monthly on the first trading day, exiting any position that falls out of the top 3.
source:
# US Industrials/Materials Momentum Long-Short Strategy
#
# RULES:
# - Universe: 10 US industrial/materials equities (CENX, CLF, CMC, STLD, FCX, SCCO, AA, NUE, X, RS)
# - Signal: 6-month momentum (126-day Rate of Change)
# - Selection: Long top 3, Short bottom 3 by momentum
# - Weighting: Equal weight within long/short portfolios
# - Rebalancing: Monthly (first trading day)

# Data source - DAILY
src = market_data_source(timeframe=1D)()
close = src.c

# 6-month momentum (126 trading days)
momentum_12m = roc(period=252)(close)

# Cross-sectional selection: top 3 by momentum (long only)
is_top_3 = cs_select(direction=CSSelectDirection.top, mode=CSSelectMode.count, k=3)(momentum_12m)

# Detect first trading day of month
is_new_month = is_period_boundary(period=PeriodType.month)(index())

# Monthly rebalance signals for LONG positions
enter_long = is_new_month and is_top_3
exit_long = is_new_month and not is_top_3
held_long = hold_until()(enter=enter_long, exit=exit_long)

# Entry zones (long-only: no short_entry)
long_and_short_zone()(long_entry=held_long)

# Equal weight across active long positions
weights = equal_weight()(held_long)

# Position sizing - rebalance on first trading day of month
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=weights * 100, rebalance_on=is_new_month)
